text:
The Senators have been in the middle of the league's biggest injury news without being the ones hurt. Nathan MacKinnon (out a month) and Cale Makar (two weeks) were both injured against Ottawa, per The Athletic. Ottawa's own scare came when Nick Cousins took a hard hit from Jakob Chychrun; he is out 7 to 10 days.

The team itself is quietly good. Ottawa is 13-6-2 with 28 points and points in five straight (4-0-1), with 56% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in that run. Over the season it has taken 53% of the five-on-five chances, and results match process almost exactly. Our playoff odds sit at 83%.

The engine is on the back end. Thomas Chabot and Jordan Spence have outscored teams 16-6 with 59% of the chances, the best pair on the team by a distance. Shane Pinto scored twice against Colorado, including the overtime winner on his birthday. Ridly Greig scored in his return, and the line of Claude Giroux, Michael Amadio and Greig has dominated in a small sample. Tim Stutzle with Dylan Cozens and Fabian Zetterlund has outscored teams 4-0.

Off the ice, Amadio has hired an agent ahead of extension talks and reports have the team and Andre Burakovsky heading for a split. Linus Ullmark is back in the mix in net. What we'd watch: how Travis Green splits the crease now that Ullmark is healthy.
